headline: Tigers opt to bat first in one-off Test against Afghanistan
summary: Bangladesh won the toss and elected to bat in their first-ever Test match played at a neutral venue.
details: Bangladesh won the toss and elected to bat first in their one-off Test against Afghanistan today at the Zayed Cricket Stadium in Abu Dhabi.
This match marks a historic milestone for the Tigers, as it is the first Test they have played at a neutral venue.
Bangladesh enters the contest following a historic 1-1 draw in their Test series against Australia in August.
Afghanistan is looking to recover from a significant innings-and-300-run defeat to India in their one-off Test match held in June.
The Bangladesh squad is led by captain Najmul Hossain Shanto and includes key players like Mushfiqur Rahim, Mehidy Hasan Miraz, and Litton Das.
The Afghanistan side is captained by Rahmat Shah and features players such as Hashmatullah Shahidi and Ikram Alikhil.
caption:

Bangladesh enters the contest following a historic 1-1 draw in their Test series against Australia in August.

Afghanistan is looking to recover from a significant innings-and-300-run defeat to India in their one-off Test match held in June.

The Bangladesh squad is led by captain Najmul Hossain Shanto and includes key players like Mushfiqur Rahim, Mehidy Hasan Miraz, and Litton Das.

The Afghanistan side is captained by Rahmat Shah and features players such as Hashmatullah Shahidi and Ikram Alikhil.
